original: The park takes its name from the Glenveagh Valley (Gleann Bheatha, German 'Valley of Life', actually probably gleann bheithe, 'Valley of the Birch'), which splits the park into two parts.
translated: Der Park hat seinen Namen vom Glenveagh-Tal (Gleann Bheatha, deutsch "Tal des Lebens", eigentlich wahrscheinlich "Tal der Birke"), das den Park in zwei Teile teilt.
method: Argos en-de offline; language-quality review not certified
